about: The treatments students tick in their profile (plan-my-month asks once), grouped by treatment type. 'version' is the pack each treatment's posts come from. The first four in each type are the clickable options; students can type any other. 'note' is a reminder for writing about it; the full careful-wording rules are in engine/treatment-rules.md. Lash and brow, Hair, Nails, Beauty and Teeth whitening (Frances, 2026-11-23: hairdressers, lash techs, nail techs and beauty salons) have no pack of their own yet: starter_plan.py takes their posts from the closest pack (STAND_INS) and plan-my-month rewrites every one fully for their treatment.

Laser.name: Laser facial
Laser.note: a skin treatment, so it uses the skin version

Laser.name: IPL facial
Laser.note: a skin treatment, so it uses the skin version

Skin.name: SkinPen microneedling
Skin.note: a course; results build and vary

Skin.name: Chemical peels
Skin.note: a cosmetic treatment: downtime and suitability vary with the peel, so never 'no downtime' unless it's true for theirs

Skin.name: Skin resurfacing
Skin.note: say which resurfacing they mean (a peel, microneedling, laser resurfacing); downtime varies, a consultation first

Aesthetics.name: Polynucleotides
Aesthetics.note: a course, results build over weeks and vary; no 'regenerates', 'repairs' or 'boosts collagen' promises

Aesthetics.name: Dermal fillers
Aesthetics.note: never for under-18s; never next to anti-wrinkle injections in the same post

Aesthetics.name: Skin boosters
Aesthetics.note: an injectable: never for under-18s; look-of-the-skin words only

Aesthetics.name: Lines and wrinkles consultations
Aesthetics.note: anti-wrinkle injections can't be advertised: only the consultation is promoted

Body.name: Lymphatic drainage
Body.note: a gentle massage: never health or detox claims; new or unexplained swelling goes to a healthcare professional first
